note: Chicago at zoom 15.5 and pitch 45 on the liberty base, which nothing else in the suite uses, turned to each of the four cardinal bearings. The page rotates the camera every frame, and a rotation has no state behind it, so the four bearings are four cameras. It found two faults. The first: a viewport-anchored light was never turned by the camera, so every wall was shaded as though the map had not rotated -- bearing 0 read 25 and 90, 180 and 270 read 25269, 16460 and 22070. Fixed in #212, after which they read 25, 50, 5 and 7822. The second is the oracle's. maplibre-native's `transformMat3f` writes its output over its input: `out[0]` is computed first, and `out[1]` then reads the `x` it has just overwritten. The viewport-anchored light is turned through that function, so upstream's light is rotated wrongly at every bearing whose sine is not zero. Reproducing the aliasing here collapses the four cardinals to 25, 50, 5 and 66 -- bearing 270 falls from 7822 -- and an eight-bearing sweep lines up with how far the two rotations diverge: 0 and 180 are 0 degrees apart and read 25 and 5; 135 is 4.5 and reads 9; 45 and 90 are 9.5 and read 50; 315 is 15.1 and reads 95; 225 is 25.7 and reads 83079; 270 is 38.6 and reads 7822. maplibre/maplibre-native#4662 fixes it upstream and is open. Until it lands this example cannot reach zero at those bearings without reproducing the bug, which is why the number is recorded rather than chased. An earlier reading of the same residual -- one wall family taking a different directional term, from the constant 0.734 ratio at 225 -- was wrong: the ratios at 270 are bimodal and reciprocal, 0.735 and 1.36, which is a light pointing somewhere else rather than a term applied to one family. The page also removes the label layers, which needs a `remove_layer` the header does not have; the labels stay, and both renderers draw the same ones -- over the buildings rather than masked by them, which is what the oracle does too (at bearing 180 the two frames agree to 5 pixels of 786432 while both draw street names across the tower faces).
